kind: Completed reward-refinement physical review and unpublished portable package

protocol.moving: 3 seconds zero, 30 seconds command, 8 seconds zero
protocol.conditions: Seed1, actor mean, saved nominal dynamics, no noise/DR/pushes; standard reset includes one zero-action warmup tick.
protocol.distance: Primary attainment is the first observed50Hz sample reaching signed progress along the command-onset world lateral direction, anchored to index149. Search only the30s motion segment; stop/failure/reset cannot complete distance. Actual attained progress and maximum cross-track through that sample are retained. Optional bracket-linear interpolation is an estimate, not a known exact continuous-time first hit. Prefix statistics use actual50Hz samples through first_ge; no extrapolation.
protocol.metric_note: All bias is actual minus external request. Heading is pose-derived. Decomposition rotates full body xyz using the recorded quaternion.
protocol.bounded_budget: One final six-case invocation and one 58s navigation invocation; no intermediate, training, optimizer smoke or historical replay.

forward.cross_track_definition: Line through moving-segment start pose along its initial heading; heading from unwrapped pose projection, not integrated body angular-z
forward.speed: Report achieved body vx, bias and RMSE alongside trajectory; slowing/stopping to meet the path targets is unacceptable. Use .45-.55 m/s mean and <=.04 m/s RMSE as a declared development comparison band.

stand.rotation: Also report late body angular-z RMS/bias and full 30 s pose-derived heading change. Both must improve over CK499 (.00670 rad/s RMS, -11.1 deg); translation alone cannot qualify holding. Retain comparison to CK250 (.00030 rad/s late RMS).
stand.startup: Report 0-5 s displacement/path separately from late hold

frozen_criteria.stopping: No material increase in full 8 s stop path, backward excursion/reversal, or final residual motion versus CK499. Report endpoint and path separately, early braking and final 2 s XY/yaw; compare CK250 and original V3 too. CK499 fast stop endpoint/path .0311/.1051 m, final XY RMS .00544 m/s.
frozen_criteria.stepping: Retain both lateral and yaw signs, partial +/- .03 commands, physical cycles/clearance distribution and loaded motion; no material regression in tracking/cross-axis drift or transitions. Existing partial lateral cross-axis drift remains unqualified.
frozen_criteria.placement: Move actual front/rear widths and pair midpoints toward the saved corridor while retaining support, height, tracking, stops and necessary corrective actions; no falls/non-wheel contacts or worsening saturation hidden by averages.
frozen_criteria.material_change: Use the previous approximately 15% comparison bands descriptively for stop path/reversal and retained-step metrics; inspect absolute magnitudes, censored cycles and signs. This is not a universal pass/fail or safety certification. Do not silently relax the stated path/heading/stand targets after results.

training.interpretation: Episode plots are episode sums/configured60s, not mean episode returns or success probabilities. Changed-objective raw return cannot rank policies. No event-causality inference.

selection.acceptance_decision_required: Whether to accept a raw-policy nominal flat-ground diagnostic Sim2Sim test with lateral bouts limited to 2m at +/-0.3m/s, despite first-2m heading errors -3.526/+4.472deg, maximum cross-track .01218/.04594m, full-30s lateral curvature 1.202/1.235m, repeated apex clipping, and lateral stop-path increases versus CK1000. These are observed deviations, not passed application tolerances.

proposed_restricted_test.environment: Flat, open, obstacle-free simulator area; nominal matched dynamics; ground-truth velocity at authored base origin; no DR, pushes or hardware.
proposed_restricted_test.command_subset: Stand; forward up to .5m/s; lateral +/- .3m/s for at most 2m per bout; short yaw up to +/- .8rad/s; explicit zero-command stops between motions.
proposed_restricted_test.controller: Unmodified deterministic 58-input actor. No heading adapter, deadband, hidden path inputs or action override.
proposed_restricted_test.not_inferred: No qualification of arbitrary mixed Cartesian-box combinations, reserve extremes, 150N recovery, hardware, or PhysX agreement.

limitations: One deterministic nominal sequential screen; commands share the preceding state and are not independently reset cases.
Arcs, mixed motion and pure yaw request rotation. Their pose heading changes are not scored against zero heading; body angular-z is not Euler yaw derivative during tilt.
The first/last1s windows each use their own measured onset for local displacement. Full-segment geometry retains the actual segment onset.
Sampled50Hz contact/force records can miss shorter substep events. Contact sample counts are not event counts or failure probabilities.
Sensor metrics use rigid-body positions and velocities, including the signed squared cross term; they do not measure image quality.
This screen does not qualify the Cartesian command box, expanded holds, disturbances, DR, hardware or general path following.
